literal: Even begging giving indeed is like, withholding even in dream those who do not know with.
translation: Begging is as joyful as giving itself, when asking from those who do not know how to withhold even in their dreams.
modern: கனவில் கூடத் தாம் உள்ளதை மறைக்கத் தெரியாதவர்களிடம் சென்று ஒன்றை யாசிப்பது, பிறருக்குக் கொடுப்பதற்குச் சமமான இன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet elevates the act of asking for help when it is directed at the truly generous. The word 'karattal' means concealing or withholding what one has from those who ask. When one approaches people who do not even dream of withholding their wealth, the act of begging loses its usual sting. In such cases, asking brings as much joy and dignity as the act of giving itself.
